description: Synthetic evaluation material, not Thermolio business facts. Three queries per document: exact, paraphrase, and French.

documents.text: The approved logo is available as an SVG. Keep clear space around the mark and never stretch its proportions. Use the supplied green and black variations.
queries: logo SVG
Which graphic can I resize without losing quality?
Où trouver les règles du logo et ses proportions ?

documents.text: Supplier invoices require a purchase order number and approval from the budget owner. Send approved invoices to accounts payable for payment within thirty days.
queries: supplier invoices
How do we get a vendor bill paid?
Comment faire payer une facture fournisseur ?

documents.text: Employees request annual leave through their manager. Submit holiday dates at least two weeks before departure and arrange coverage before approval.
queries: annual leave
Who approves my vacation?
Comment demander des congés annuels ?

documents.text: Workspace accounts require an approved company email and an authenticator app. Report a lost device immediately so access can be revoked.
queries: authenticator
I lost the phone used to sign in. What now?
Que faire si je perds mon téléphone de connexion ?

documents.text: Boiler maintenance includes an annual safety inspection and a monthly pressure check. Record defects in the service log and arrange repairs with the maintenance lead.
queries: boiler maintenance
How often do we inspect the heating equipment?
À quelle fréquence faut-il inspecter la chaudière ?

documents.text: Every new project begins with a kickoff meeting. Agree on objectives, name the project owner, record the schedule and confirm the deliverables with the client.
queries: kickoff meeting
What should we agree before starting client work?
Que faut-il préparer au début d'un projet client ?

documents.text: Travel expense claims must include receipts and the business purpose of the trip. Submit mileage and accommodation costs within fourteen days of returning.
queries: travel expense
Can I claim my hotel and driving costs?
Comment se faire rembourser les frais de déplacement ?

documents.text: If a suspicious email requests credentials, do not open its links. Report phishing to the security contact and preserve the original message for investigation.
queries: phishing
Someone emailed asking for my password. What should I do?
Comment signaler un courriel qui demande mon mot de passe ?

documents.text: Public writing should use plain language, short sentences and a calm professional tone. Avoid unsupported claims and explain benefits with specific examples.
queries: professional tone
How should our customer-facing copy sound?
Quel ton utiliser pour communiquer avec les clients ?

documents.text: Project handover includes the final report, approved drawings, operating instructions and a list of open issues. Obtain written acceptance from the client.
queries: project handover
What documents do we deliver when the job finishes?
Quels documents remettre à la fin du projet ?

documents.text: A new employee receives a company laptop, an introduction to the team and a named mentor. The manager reviews the first month's responsibilities during orientation.
queries: new employee
What happens on a colleague's first day?
Comment accueillir un nouveau collègue ?

documents.text: Record electricity meter readings every fifteen minutes. Check missing intervals before comparing monthly energy consumption or estimating savings.
queries: meter readings
How frequently do we measure electricity use?
À quelle fréquence relever la consommation électrique ?

documents.text: The finance team reviews spending against the approved budget every month. Explain variances and obtain approval before exceeding a project allocation.
queries: budget variances
What happens if a project is spending more than planned?
Que faire si les dépenses dépassent le budget prévu ?

documents.text: Encrypted backups are created daily. Recovery exercises verify that files can be restored. Restrict backup access to authorized administrators.
queries: encrypted backups
How can we recover files after a system failure?
Comment restaurer les fichiers après une panne ?

documents.text: Meeting notes record decisions, action owners and due dates. Share the approved minutes with attendees and follow up on outstanding actions at the next meeting.
queries: meeting notes
Where do we track who promised to do what?
Comment suivre les décisions et les actions après une réunion ?

documents.text: Maintain an inventory of spare temperature sensors. Record the serial number when a device is installed or replaced and reorder when fewer than five remain.
queries: temperature sensors
When should we buy more spare monitoring devices?
Quand faut-il commander de nouveaux capteurs de température ?

Quel est le code du coffre-fort ?
What is the CEO's personal medical history?
